text: 花旗发表研报指，对中国房地产行业维持正面看法，受惠于核心城市成交韧性及低基数效应推动，9月起发展商加强推售新盘，加上憧憬7月底举行的政治局会议将释放支持讯号，例如公积金购房及以旧换新等措施或进一步放宽，相信7月至9月行业销售增长有望回稳。该行认为内房行业已为8月至10月的升浪做好准备，将华润置地、建发国际、贝壳、中国金茂及中国海外发展视为首选股。
text_en: Citi maintains a positive view on China's real estate sector, citing resilient core city sales and a low base effect. Developers are expected to ramp up new project launches from September, with hopes that the Politburo meeting in late July will signal support measures, such as easing provident fund home purchases and trade-in policies, stabilizing sales growth from July to September. The sector is set for an August-October rally, with top picks being CR Land, C&D International, Beike, China Jinmao, and China Overseas Land & Investment.
